title: TUI crashes when terminal window is resized below 80 columns
body:
The TUI panics with an index out of bounds error when the terminal window is resized to less than 80 columns wide.

Stack trace:
```
thread 'main' panicked at 'index out of bounds: the len is 3 but the index is 5'
```

This happens in the openshell-tui crate's render loop.

comments.body: I'll look into this. Probably need to add a minimum size check.
